name: isNat_pow
statement: ∀ {f : α → ℕ → α} {a : α} {b a' b' c : ℕ}, f = HPow.hPow → IsNat a a' → IsNat b b' → Nat.pow a' b' = c → IsNat (f a b) c | _, _, _, _, _, _, rfl, ⟨rfl⟩, ⟨rfl⟩, rfl => ⟨by simp⟩  -- see note [norm_num lemma function equality] theorem isInt_pow {α} [Ring α] : ∀ {f : α → ℕ → α} {a : α} {b : ℕ} {a' : ℤ} {b' : ℕ} {c : ℤ}, f = HPow.hPow → IsInt a a' → IsNat b b' → Int.pow a' b' = c → IsInt (f a b) c | _, _, _, _, _, _, rfl, ⟨rfl⟩, ⟨rfl⟩, rfl => ⟨by simp⟩  -- see note [norm_num lemma function equality] theorem isRat_pow {α} [Ring α] {f : α → ℕ → α} {a : α} {an cn : ℤ} {ad b b' cd : ℕ} : f = HPow.hPow → IsRat a an ad → IsNat b b' → Int.pow an b' = cn → Nat.pow ad b' = cd → IsRat (f a b) cn cd

name: isNNRat_pow
